name: Gumbo's Gambit
author: Minty
summary: When a tile falls, the tile under it begins to crumble.
description: A common crumble gambit that chains falls downward. Whenever a tile falls off the board, the tile directly below it starts crumbling and drops on the next turn, so a single fall can cascade down a column until it reaches the edge of the board or your stock. Any leftover crumbling tiles are reset when the game ends. Costs 4 in the shop and unlocks automatically. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs alongside it.
